ValidationRule.description: Allow GDS Status edit on Blank and New
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(OR($Profile.Name=='QAC API Integration Profile',$Profile.Name=='System Administrator',$Profile.Name=='Qantas System Administrator',$Profile.Name=='Qantas System Admin - Freight',$Profile.Name=='Qantas System Admin - QCC',$Profile.Name=='Qantas System Admin - SND',$Profile.Name=='Data Administrator')) && IF(ISCHANGED( GDS_Status__c ),NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL( GDS_Status__c,'New'), ISPICKVAL(GDS_Status__c,''))),false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to edit GDS Status
